notes.title: Version 3.12.2 (312020)
notes.notes: Added WebP output support: A modern format offering excellent compression while preserving image details like PNG, but with significantly smaller file sizes.

notes.title: Version 3.12.1 (312010)
notes.notes:
Improved navigation experience with mouse and keyboard
 Fixed crash when dragging the app window between monitors

notes.title: Version 3.12.0 (312002)
notes.notes:
✨ More Anime Upscaling Options

We’ve added x4 and x9 anime upscaling alongside the existing x16 scale, giving you more flexibility to choose between faster results and finer details.

notes.title: Version 3.10.0 (310000)
notes.notes:
✨ Presets for Enhance Portrait Mode

Now you can switch between two enhancement styles to get the look you prefer:

 Smooth – Clean and soft look with lighter details

 Realistic – More accurate facial features and true-to-life appearance



[img src="https://i.ibb.co/FbYjwjXS/enhance-portrait-presets-comparison.png"]

notes.title: Version 3.7.0 (37001)
notes.notes:
🛠 Custom Models Supercharged
https://i.ibb.co/p1KLkdB/Frame-5.png

Enjoy up to 70% faster execution times when using custom ML models.

Other Improvements:

 Custom models are now automatically saved after import
 Output filenames now include the custom model name as a suffix (can be disabled in Settings)
